fortunes.text: The light you carry also casts a shadow on someone you love. Let it.
A door you've sealed will open on its own. Leave it unlocked.
You will be asked to share what you're saving. Give it away.
The sweetness you taste tonight is earned, not given.
A light you light for others will find its way back to you.
This festival, you are the blessing. Remember that.
The spark you've been waiting for is in your hand already.
You will find what you lost in a place you haven't looked: within.
A wish whispered tonight travels further than one spoken aloud.
The darkness before you is not empty. It's waiting for your light.
You will be surprised by who shows up. It's the one you didn't invite.
The tradition you keep alive is keeping you alive too.
The fire you're afraid of is the same one that will warm you. Stand closer.
You will be given a key tonight. It opens something you built and forgot.
A family secret surfaces. It was always meant to be shared.
The wealth you're counting is in the wrong ledger. Check again.
Someone is praying for you right now. You've never met.
This is the year you stop dimming your light for someone else's comfort.
The enemy you've been fighting is actually an ally in disguise. Put down the weapon.
You will be asked to forgive. It's not for them. It never was.
The light you bring will illuminate something you've been avoiding. That's the point.
You will be tested by abundance, not scarcity. This is harder than you think.
The person you're performing for has already left the room. Be yourself.
You will out-shine someone, and it will cost you. Shine anyway.
This festival, the prayer you whisper for yourself will be answered by a stranger.
The light you light tonight will outlive you. Someone will remember it long after you're gone.
You are the miracle you've been waiting for. The universe has been waiting for you to realize it.
The darkness you've been running from is actually your greatest teacher. Turn around.
The rangoli you make will be swept away. Make it anyway.
You'll eat too much. That's the point of the festival.
A new tradition begins tonight. You'll be the one who starts it.
The wealth you accumulate will mean nothing. The wealth you distribute will mean everything.
This Diwali, you will understand why the flame needs the darkness. Both are necessary. Both are yours.
